cards.title: Shrinking a number
cards.body: `n // 10` drops the last digit. Do it again and again, and the number shrinks until it reaches 0.
cards.code:
n = 345
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n = n // 10

hi.title: Number ko chhota karna
hi.body: `n // 10` last digit hata deta hai. Ise baar baar karo, toh number chhota hote hote 0 tak pahunch jaata hai.

cards.title: Counting rounds
cards.body: Add 1 to a counter each time the loop runs to find out how many rounds it took.
cards.code:
n = 50
steps = 0
while n > 1:
    n = n // 2
    steps += 1
print(steps)

hi.title: Rounds ginna
hi.body: Har baar loop chalne par counter mein 1 jodo, toh pata chal jaayega kitne rounds lage.

cards.title: Test the edge cases
cards.body: Always try the smallest input too. What does your loop do when the number is 0, and how many digits does 0 have?

hi.title: Edge cases test karo
hi.body: Hamesha sabse chhota input bhi try karo. Number 0 ho toh aapka loop kya karta hai, aur 0 mein kitne digits hain?

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should add up the digits of 123 and print 6, but it never finishes. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
n = int(input())
total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    n = n % 10
print(total)

bug.fix: `n % 10` keeps the last digit, so `n` never reaches 0. Line 5 should drop it instead: `n = n // 10`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 123 ke digits jodkar 6 print karna chahiye, par yeh kabhi khatam nahi hota. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `n % 10` last digit rakhta hai, isliye `n` kabhi 0 tak nahi pahunchta. Line 5 ko use hatana chahiye: `n = n // 10`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.code:
n = 7
count = 0
while n > 0:
    n //= 10
    count += 1
print(count)
check.explanation: 7 // 10 is 0, so the loop runs exactly once.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 7 // 10 ka matlab 0, isliye loop theek ek baar chalta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a whole number (0 or more) and print how many digits it has. Do it with arithmetic: keep dividing by 10 with `//` in a loop.
